description: This script runs automated tests to verify git submodule behavior on detached working trees and with custom core.worktree configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the specified message.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files, asserting they are identical.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the testing script as completed.
